# Waves

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_stats.py from config/*.yaml; don't edit by hand. -->

Generated from the game's config by [`scripts/gen_stats.py`](https://github.com/vectorviolet/chokepoint/blob/main/scripts/gen_stats.py); don't edit it by hand. [Back to the index](README.md).

What each wave sends, in spawn order. **Interval** is the time between two spawns. **Total HP** and **Kill money** add up every enemy of the wave at that wave's scaling (see [Enemies](enemies.md)). **Lives at stake** is what the wave costs if every enemy escapes. **Money if all killed** is the starting $200 plus every kill so far, before anything is spent.

Clearing wave 25 wins the run. Waves after 30 are generated by the game (endless mode): the mix of wave 30, every group growing each wave (tanks more slowly) and the spawn interval shortening down to a floor of 400 ms. The first 10 are listed.
